name: Library Volunteer (ages 14 and up)
what_you_do: Volunteers help with tech tutoring, the Makerspace, shelf adopting and shelf reading, and special events. Staff match you to a need.
who_can_apply: At least 14 years old. Under 18 needs a parent or guardian to co-sign and working papers. Everyone is interviewed.
how_to_apply: Fill out the volunteer application and sign the code of conduct and harassment policies. Staff contact you if there is a fit, then interview you.
notes: The library page says teens under 18 need working papers, even to volunteer. Volunteers may not sort or shelve books.
